title: Online backup fatal-error classification

scope.rationale: isFatalError is the single retryability predicate used by backup step and per-page update paths: success and lock contention are nonfatal, while all other results permanently stop copy/update work.

external_source_responsibilities: Step and update owners preserve retryable busy state
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete source predicate is assigned. Both typed step and update owners consume it before continuing copy work.

inputs: Optional typed backup error, where null represents SQLITE_OK
outputs: False for success or Busy; true for every other representable backup error
contracts.state_and_results: The bounded backup Error set cannot produce SQLITE_LOCKED, so Busy is its sole lock-contention alternative and all remaining errors are fatal.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No locks, callbacks, allocation, or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: The classifier itself cannot fail. False permits retry/continuation; true preserves the stored failure.

representation_differences: SQLITE_LOCKED is absent from the typed local Error set; if introduced, this predicate must add it as nonfatal before callers can produce it.

oracle.protocol: Classify null success, Busy, Io, and Done; require only success and Busy to be nonfatal, then execute a completed backup step through the consuming owner.
oracle.normalization: Compare exact booleans and typed step errors.

assurance.malformed_input: Closed typed error set and null success constrain input.
assurance.continuation: Busy remains retryable; all other errors remain sticky.

integration.native_call_path: step and update call isFatalError before retrying, recopying, or returning stored state; owner trace exercises success, Busy, Io, Done, and complete copy.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The inline step failure!=Busy condition is retired.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C result matrix, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Connect the internal source-shaped backup state machine to the public Backup owner.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/backup.c structure/thread-safety notes, isFatalError, backupOnePage, step, and update callers were reviewed
src/core/internal/backup_core.zig complete state machine, typed Error set, step/update callers, and owner trace were reviewed
assertions_branches_cleanup: The sole source return block is assigned
ALWAYS(rc!=SQLITE_LOCKED) corresponds to the typed Error set excluding Locked
upstream_tests: Upstream backup busy/locked, OOM, I/O, completion, and update tests exercise this predicate
Project owner trace exercises exact local result classes and consuming step
